versions.content: Error Name: WETH_ E_ACCESS Short Descripti on: Wireless Ethernet Controller Access Failure. Long Description: Monitors the access to the Wireless Ethernet Controller . Detection Criteria: Fail When access to the Wireless Ethernet Controller fails the module shall report the extended production err or with event status DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREFAILED to DEM. Pass When access to the Wireless Ethernet Controller succeeds the module shall report the extended production error with event status DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREPASSED to DEM. Secondary Parameters: None . Time Required: None. Monitor Frequency None .
